items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:22:1
items.html: ZON have externality and internality: You already know that all the lights of Atzilut come only to correct the vessels and the statures that came out in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim and were nullified. You also know that the ZAT of Nekudim received from two particular Partzufim: the four kings of HGT received the four statures from above downward, from the four statures that came out in AVI of Nekudim; and the four kings of NHYM received from the four statures of YESHSUT of Nekudim, as I wrote at length in Part 7. And with this you will understand that the correction of the four statures from the Chazeh downward of the ZAT of Nekudim are the discernments of the NRNHY [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida] of the externality of ZON of Atzilut; and the four statures of HGT, from the Chazeh upward of the ZAT of Nekudim, are the NRNHY of the internality of ZON of Atzilut.
